Lernayin Artsakh FC is an association football club formerly based in Stepanakert, breakaway Republic of Artsakh but is registered in the town of Vayk, Vayots Dzor Province, Armenia. The club was founded in 1927 in Soviet Azerbaijan and its current name translates from Armenian as \"Mountainous Artsakh\".
